text_block_list.text: —The day of the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey's definitely got this one! 
Her performance during the Classic year 
was the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of contenders, but 
personally, I'm rooting for Kawakami 
Princess. She's had so many close calls 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame Vodka's been in a bit of a 
slump since the Derby, isn't it? I really 
wanted to see her run in the Osaka Hai, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume on the Tiara route are 
still getting so much attention, huh. 
Daiwa Scarlet's in great form, too—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally the first race of the 
'Spring Senior Triple Crown,' isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We should be able to learn a lot of new 
things from today's race.
choice_data_list:
...Your standing in the Senior Class, 
right?

...It's about your standing in the Senior 
Class, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed— Can I continue to face the "storm" 
from here on out, or not?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Let us ascertain the truth thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah... I am truly looking forward to it—

"...It wasn't my imagination. I could tell 
Dream Journey was looking forward to 
today's race far more than words could 
say."

And I feel just as exhilarated. As if I've 
just set foot on brand-new soil.
choice_data_list:
Let's begin our journey for the Spring 
Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Do your best today!! I'm cheering for you, 
Dream Journey!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Show us your strength in the Senior Year 
too!! I can't wait to see it!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (There's more cheering than I expected...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(..."Anego's" true worth won't show until 
the Senior Class.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(I suppose they're comparing me, as his 
follower, to see how well I can perform in 
the Senior Class...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well, setting that aside—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Let's begin. The race that will foretell 
this coming year—)
